messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi there! I’m having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone. It’s been happening for the past few hours, and I’d really like to get it working again. Can you help me figure out what’s going on?

To assist you with the MMS issue, I first need to identify you as a customer. Could you please provide me with your phone number, or your full name along with your date of birth? This will help me look up your account and check the relevant details.
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information from me.

Thank you, John. I have identified your active line associated with the phone number 555-123-2002 and your device details. To diagnose the MMS sending issue, I will first check if your phone can send MMS messages properly.
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.
It looks like my messaging app currently cannot send MMS messages. What should I do next to try and fix this?

Your line is active and your data usage is within the limit of your Premium Plan, so data allowance is not the issue.

Next, let's check some technical settings on your phone that could affect MMS sending, such as network status, APN settings, and permissions. Could you please confirm if you are currently able to make calls and use mobile data on your phone?

Yes, please turn off Airplane Mode first. This will enable your phone's wireless radios, including cellular service. After that, please enable mobile data on your phone. Once both are done, let me know, and we can continue troubleshooting your MMS issue.

Your phone's network mode preference being set to 2G only can cause MMS sending issues because 2G networks generally do not support MMS well.

I recommend changing your network mode preference to 4G/5G preferred for better MMS support and overall improved data connectivity.
